query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('states',(SELECT jsonb_object_agg(state,n) FROM (SELECT state,count(*) AS n FROM routelens_p05.trips GROUP BY state) s),'traversals',(SELECT count(*) FROM routelens_p05.traversals),'candidates',(SELECT count(*) FROM routelens_p06.candidates),'candidate_statuses',(SELECT jsonb_agg(DISTINCT e->>'status') FROM routelens_p06.candidates c CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(convert_from(c.canonical_json,'UTF8')::jsonb->'entries') e));
message_en: Independent read-only observation while the P06 development harness was live; not final state.
message_ko: P06 개발 실행 중 메인이 별도로 읽은 상태이며 최종 결과가 아닙니다.
